xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes
1 The consolidated financial results comprise the financial results of the Co and its subsidiaries and its joint ventures

2 The Groups primary business segment is reflected on the principal business activities carried on by the entities in the Group in the following operating segments Consumer Durables Division Electronics Division and Railway Sub system and Defense Division

3 On 12 June 2024 the Holding Co has also acquired additional 181282 equity shares of IL JIN amounting to Rs 3,322 lakhs at Rs 1833 per share from its minority shareholders Resulting to same, the Holding Company shareholding increased from 85 to 90 in IL JIN

4 On 25 May 2024 the Holding Co has acquired additional 1106937 equity shares of Ever amounting to Rs 6863 lacs at Rs 620 per share from its minority shareholders Resulting to same the Holding Co shareholding increased from 70 to 90 in Ever

5 The Reconstruction Committee of the Board in their meeting held on 7 Sep 2024 approved the acquisition of the part of the business of AmberPR through a slump sale on a going concern basis for a consideration of Rs 1867 lakh with effect from 1 Oct 2024 and the Holding Co has provided the effect of the slump sale in these financial results in accordance with Appendix C Business combinations of entities under common control of Ind AS 103 Business Combinations Accordingly the comparable financial results and other financial information included in these financial results have also been restated to give effect of the slump sale

6 The Board of Holding Co and AmberPR has further approved the said scheme to revise the appointed date of the scheme to 1 April 2025 from the earlier approved date of 1 April 24 in their meeting dated 17 May 2025 and 12 May 2025 respectively The Company is in the process of filing the scheme with NCLT for required approvals

7 The Joint Venture Committee 2 of the Board of the ILJIN at their meeting held on 15 Oct 24 approved formation of a joint venture alliance with KCC to carry on the business of manufacturing of HDI, Flex, Semiconductor Substrates PCBs and the joint venture agreement has been executed on 15 Oct 24 Subsequent to the year ended 31 Mar 2025 the Company namely Ascent K Circuit Private Limited has been incorporated on 7 Apr 2025
